effective_date_note: Cover page reads 'Effective May 1, 2025'. Document is the Lopi 2025 Illustrated Price List that Drew filed in his FP Central index under 'September 2025'. No newer Lopi MSRP was issued between May and September 2025 per the cover; the file is the current-as-of-Sept-2025 reference.
price_field_note: Lopi publishes a single MSRP column in this Illustrated Price List (no separate Dealer column). msrp = MSRP value from the PDF. dealer_price left null — BisTrack is the source of truth for Benson dealer cost.
extraction_method_note: Source PDF is a scanned 72-page document (Print-to-PDF, image-only). All values OCR'd via tesseract from 150 dpi grayscale renders, with right-column re-crops to recover prices missed by full-page OCR. Spot-verified prices against multiple OCR passes. Sub-models with garbled OCR are flagged needs_ocr_verification = true and their msrp left null.
